verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a built-in web UI served via `llama serve` (llama-cpp-gh-3, llama-cpp-gh-18) that provides a graphical chat interface, distinct from the CLI-only chat mode. However, community evidence in the pack focuses on CLI/mtmd usage for vision chat rather than hands-on use of the web GUI itself, so independent corroboration of the graphical interface's usability is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on reports of using the web UI specifically, screenshots or feature details of the chat GUI, and confirmation of feature parity with CLI (e.g., multimodal support in the UI).
